<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#000000"/>
      <stop offset="58%" stop-color="#101818"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#728887"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="hero" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0.9" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#465454"/>
      <stop offset="48%" stop-color="#1b2929"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="car" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#dce7e5"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#728887"/>
      <stop offset="75%" stop-color="#243333"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#080b0b"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="180%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="7" stdDeviation="7" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".72"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="soft" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="180%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".6"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#000000" opacity=".9"/>
  
  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="20" y="20" font-family="Inter" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5">
    <line x1="326" y1="19" x2="326" y2="15"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="19" x2="331" y2="12"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="19" x2="336" y2="9"/>
    <circle cx="349" cy="15" r="4"/>
    <line x1="346" y1="12" x2="352" y2="18"/>
    <line x1="356" y1="11" x2="356" y2="19"/>
    <line x1="360" y1="14" x2="360" y2="19"/>
    <line x1="364" y1="16" x2="364" y2="19"/>
    <rect x="371" y="10" width="16" height="10" rx="2"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="373" y="12" width="11" height="6" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="32" cy="59" r="19" fill="#46545469" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".22"/>
    <line x1="23" y1="53" x2="41" y2="53" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="23" y1="59" x2="41" y2="59" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="23" y1="65" x2="41" y2="65" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="353" cy="59" r="18" fill="#728887" opacity=".8"/>
    <circle cx="353" cy="54" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="353" cy="65" rx="8" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="56" r="13" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polygon points="195,43 198,52 207,56 198,59 195,69 192,59 183,56 192,52" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="195" y="83" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Mercedes-Benz</text>
  </g>

  <!-- welcome copy -->
  <text x="24" y="116" font-family="Nobile" font-size="26px" fill="#FFFFFF">Welcome</text>
  <text x="24" y="139" font-family="Inter" font-size="15px" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".72">Move beyond the ordinary.</text>

  <!-- hero card shadow and surface -->
  <rect x="18" y="157" width="354" height="303" rx="23" fill="#000000" opacity=".6" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <rect x="18" y="151" width="354" height="303" rx="23" fill="url(#hero)" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".15"/>
  
  <!-- fallback landscape / vehicle scene -->
  <circle cx="318" cy="194" r="30" fill="#D9D9D900" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".18"/>
  <circle cx="318" cy="194" r="10" fill="#7EC0F6" opacity=".68"/>
  <polygon points="32,365 126,279 178,333 221,292 350,391 350,438 32,438" fill="#728887" opacity=".34"/>
  <polygon points="32,397 110,328 163,374 220,337 350,417 350,438 32,438" fill="#000000" opacity=".68"/>
  
  <!-- stylized car -->
  <ellipse cx="203" cy="390" rx="135" ry="15" fill="#000000" opacity=".75"/>
  <polygon points="71,363 104,326 157,310 245,313 296,340 328,362 316,389 82,389" fill="url(#car)" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".6" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <polygon points="133,319 168,291 239,294 276,330 194,327" fill="#0a1112" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".28"/>
  <line x1="168" y1="292" x2="181" y2="326" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".24"/>
  <line x1="239" y1="295" x2="225" y2="327" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".24"/>
  <polygon points="80,358 108,337 122,344 112,365" fill="#7EC0F6" opacity=".72"/>
  <polygon points="288,350 315,362 310,373 289,367" fill="#d38c74" opacity=".76"/>
  <circle cx="125" cy="386" r="20" fill="#070909" stroke="#728887" stroke-width="5"/>
  <circle cx="125" cy="386" r="8" fill="#465454"/>
  <circle cx="281" cy="386" r="20" fill="#070909" stroke="#728887" stroke-width="5"/>
  <circle cx="281" cy="386" r="8" fill="#465454"/>
  <circle cx="203" cy="354" r="13" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="203,342 206,351 215,354 206,357 203,367 200,357 191,354 200,351" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <g>
    <rect x="34" y="173" width="104" height="28" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity=".52"/>
    <text x="86" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14px" fill="#FFFFFF">The new E-Class</text>
    <circle cx="338" cy="418" r="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="334,414 339,418 334,422" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#FFFFFF">
    <circle cx="180" cy="431" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="431" r="3" opacity=".4"/>
    <circle cx="210" cy="431" r="3" opacity=".4"/>
    <circle cx="225" cy="431" r="3" opacity=".4"/>
  </g>

  <!-- promotional slogan -->
  <text x="24" y="495" font-family="Aubrey" font-size="26px" fill="#7EC0F6">Your dream car</text>
  <text x="24" y="524" font-family="Aubrey" font-size="26px" fill="#7EC0F6">is just a button away.</text>
  <text x="24" y="548" font-family="Inter" font-size="15px" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".72">Explore every possibility.</text>
  
  <!-- actions -->
  <g filter="url(#soft)">
    <rect x="24" y="570" width="164" height="46" rx="13" fill="#728887"/>
    <text x="106" y="599" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="15px" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Explore vehicles</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="200" y="570" width="166" height="46" rx="13" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="283" y="599" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="15px" fill="#FFFFFF">Build your own</text>
  </g>

  <!-- feature strip -->
  <rect x="20" y="642" width="350" height="84" rx="23" fill="#000000" opacity=".38"/>
  <g>
    <circle cx="53" cy="674" r="18" fill="#728887"/>
    <polygon points="53,661 57,670 67,674 57,678 53,688 49,678 39,674 49,670" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="82" y="669" font-family="Inter" font-size="15px" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Discover your match</text>
    <text x="82" y="691" font-family="Inter" font-size="14px" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".66">Compare models, features and style</text>
    <polyline points="343,668 350,675 343,682" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="748" width="390" height="96" fill="#050707" opacity=".98"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="748" x2="370" y2="748" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".12"/>
  <g fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5">
    <polygon points="45,777 56,768 67,777 67,791 45,791"/>
    <polyline points="42,778 56,765 70,778" fill="none"/>
    <circle cx="128" cy="776" r="9" fill="none"/>
    <line x1="135" y1="783" x2="142" y2="790"/>
    <rect x="185" y="767" width="20" height="16" rx="3" fill="none"/>
    <polyline points="190,784 187,790 195,784" fill="none"/>
    <circle cx="268" cy="775" r="8" fill="none"/>
    <ellipse cx="268" cy="790" rx="13" ry="6" fill="none"/>
    <circle cx="335" cy="774" r="8" fill="none"/>
    <line x1="335" y1="765" x2="335" y2="783"/>
    <line x1="326" y1="774" x2="344" y2="774"/>
  </g>
  <text x="56" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14px" fill="#FFFFFF">Home</text>
  <text x="128" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14px" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".62">Vehicles</text>
  <text x="195" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14px" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".62">Garage</text>
  <text x="268" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14px" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".62">Account</text>
  <text x="335" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14px" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".62">More</text>
</svg>
